intake.user_request: Wire the MapData api block into the map viewer and dashboard so the API surface is visible where the rest of the code intelligence already is. Target project: coderef-core (cross-project WO - authored in ASSISTANT, executed against CODEREF-CORE). ORIGIN: WO-API-SURFACE-MAPPING-RECONNECT-AND-GRAPH-ELEVATION-001 close-time follow-up FU-6, which deferred P3-T4/T5 because the host repo serves zero endpoints so there was nothing to render and no way to no-regress a visual change. VERIFIED ON-DISK 2026-07-31: producer, projection and MCP tool are all LIVE (routes.json generated; .coderef/map/data.json carries a populated api block at MapData 1.7.0; api_surface registered as MCP tool 37). Both CONSUMERS are dark - grep for api in assets/map-viewer/dashboard.js returns 0 matches, and endpoint/apiSurface/networkEdge in viewer.js returns 0 matches. The data reaches the viewer and both surfaces walk past it. DESIGN RULING - OVERLAY, NOT MODE: MapApiNetworkEdge is {source, target, endpoints} where source and target are project-relative FILE paths, so both ends already exist as graph nodes and the overlay rides the existing node space as a 7th toggle copy-shaped from cycles. A mode would require a second node space (all 470 node ids are file paths; zero @Endpoint nodes reach the map by design, since endpoint nodes carry no file). Endpoint-to-endpoint topology is better served by a dashboard TABLE than a graph. SCOPE: api overlay toggle on graph.html + viewer.js (dashed stroke so an HTTP hop is never confusable with an import edge), endpoint/unmatched-call tables on dashboard.js, detail-panel endpoint rows, tri-state no-data handling, and a fixture repo with real routes. NON-GOALS: no endpoint-node graph mode; no --api CLI flag; no changes to api-surface.ts, the MCP tool, or the pipeline (all three are already correct); no new network reference (file-safe static output is absolute); no new asset file so emit-map.ts should NOT change; no restyle - the shared tokens.css palette governs.
